text:
Maya P.: Heads up — partner canary for marketplace images starts in 15m. We need final alignment on driver pin + rollback plan.
AJ (Runtime): Thanks — what are we pinning to? partner asked about CUDA 12.3 vs 12.2 compatibility.
Kevin S.: SI tested 12.3 on a100 and saw perf parity but one quant kernel regressed with 12.3+cuDNN. We flagged it yesterday.
Siya K.: Partner legal wants a pinned combo for the GA announcement. They prefer CUDA12.2 + ROCm5.4 as a safe baseline.
AJ (Runtime): OK. Proposal: canary lane = CUDA12.2 (pinned), ROCm5.4 (pinned). Parallel canary for 12.3 as opt-in with reduced traffic.
Maya P.: Can we run the 12.3 variant as a dark canary for 2 hours and only surface metrics to partners? :eyes:
AJ (Runtime): Yes. We'll spin two image tags: market-driver:cuda12-2-pin and market-driver:cuda12-3-experimental. Canary split: 95% -> pinned, 5% -> experimental.
deploy-bot: canary deploy started for market-driver:cuda12-2-pin -> cluster marketplace-canary-1 at 1750000000
Kevin S.: Ops note — regression we saw is in quant kernel QK-17. We'll add a perf guard in the canary smoke: if QK-17 token latency > 20ms p50, abort.
ops-oncall: I added a runbook check: smoke.sh does: `./smoke.sh --batch 8 --seq 1024` and checks p50/p95. I also wired alert to #eng-runtime-oncall.
Siya K.: Partner comms: we'll tell them pinned baseline + optional experimental for early adopters. Need to confirm rollback message wording.
Maya P.: Draft rollback: "If canary shows regression, we'll pause onboard and roll pinned image across marketplace nodes within 30m. We'll notify partners and open an incident." Thoughts?
Kevin S.: Add: automated rollback if QK-17 perf regression >10% for 3 consecutive 5m windows.
AJ (Runtime): Agree. Also need kernel ABI check on the node images — add `ldd` smoke to ensure driver linkages match.
ops-oncall: On it. I'll attach kernel/driver versions to the canary telemetry and post a short summary at +30m, +90m.
Maya P.: Great. @Siya can you confirm partner acknowledgement? I'll take the on-call handoff at +2h if things look stable.
Siya K.: Confirmed. Partner rep (Leah) okayed pinned baseline and dark 12.3 test. She wants daily overviews for 48h after GA.
deploy-bot: market-driver:cuda12-3-experimental dark canary deployed -> cluster marketplace-canary-1 at 1750000100
AJ (Runtime): Running full KV-cache warmup job now. If anyone needs logs: `k logs -f deploy/marketplace-canary`
Kevin S.: Monitoring shows a small uptick in QK-17 p95 on the experimental lane — watching closely.
Maya P.: Keep updates short here. If we hit rollback thresholds, ops-oncall will execute and ping #incidents.
ops-oncall: Acknowledged. I'll be standing by for the >=10% trigger.
Siya K.: I'll prep the partner note templates and the GA announcement addendum in case we postpone.
Maya P.: Thanks team. Handoff: I'll be primary contact for partner comms for the next 2h, then ops-oncall will take over bridge. :thumbsup:
AJ (Runtime): Copy. I'll keep the kernel/driver telemetry flowing and post a summary in 30m.
Kevin S.: Filing a quick ticket for QK-17 investigation: https://tickets.redwood.ai/issue/QK-17-regression
Maya P.: Closing the loop — everyone please react with :white_check_mark: when you have the runbook steps captured in your docs.
Siya K.: :white_check_mark:
AJ (Runtime): :white_check_mark:
ops-oncall: :white_check_mark:
Kevin S.: :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: canary metrics snapshot uploaded -> s3://redwood-canary/1749999999/metrics.json
Maya P.: Perfect. I'll ping Leah and update the partner thread.
